description: Load BEFORE the first edit or answer in any project whose package.json (read it first) lists `datocms-plugin-sdk`, not a Vite or other tool's plugin, even when the request never mentions DatoCMS, even for a small fix, and before creating a DatoCMS plugin or hunting a bug in one: scaffolding, connect() hooks and their ctx (field extensions, config screens, sidebar panels, pages, modals, asset sources, dropdown actions, lifecycle hooks), form values and plugin parameters, browser CMA calls, permissions, publishing, testing local changes safely. When the work adds a surface that renders UI, load `datocms-plugin-design` too. Work that only changes how a plugin looks (restyling, components, colours, dark mode, UI review, datocms-react-ui upgrade): `datocms-plugin-design` alone. Installing a plugin on a project or changing its settings through the API: `datocms-cma`. CLI plugins: `datocms-cli`.
